runtime_contract_lineage_repair.description: Exact Unified-Registry -> Hash-Lineage -> runtime-contract repair scope. It permits only the canonical contract registry, its active runtime projection, strict hash/interface guards, the formal Evidence hash-precache chain, the bounded V21.5 operating-evidence cross-validation bridge, the exact formal-signal Artifact materialization edge, Product Signal Admission as the mandatory business gate before Agent1, the exact admission-qualified formal-signal -> Agent1 handoff inside the existing single worker, deterministic Agent1 projection de-duplication under the unchanged 22k item budget, Agent3 exact-path semantic repair, completed-contract projection, structured current-state failure projection, and the frontend canonical-product Hash View repair. Competition Evidence is derived only from canonical product hashes within the active history epoch: Evidence may not force-rebuild canonical snapshots, may not scan 90 complete historical snapshot payloads, may hydrate at most two comparable compact observations, must derive one deterministic evidenceInputHash from the current canonical set/observation hashes + previous comparable hashes + historyEpochId + immutable operatingEvidenceGraph.v1/21.5.0 contract identity, and must preserve that hash through the V21.5 cross-validation overlay, fullProductBundleRef -> validatedBundleRef -> product signal ART. V22 startup must replace the historical V21.5 materialize_signal_snapshot wrapper with competition_evidence_v215_runtime_service before station execution; the historical wrapper remains compatibility source only and may not own the active competition Evidence path. Full-bundle and validation references must be immutable ART-* references produced only after existing station business validation. Signal admission may consume only the validated bundle ART; its signal ART must use that validated ART as parent. No second queue/worker, legacy Signal Pool reload, positive artificial minimum, evidence-contract broadening, Agent budget change or provider-policy change is allowed. Frontend products remain canonical-snapshot only and Signal/Agent admission may never reduce visible product inventory. Runtime membership may change only when the added/removed file is explicitly allowlisted or owned by an explicitly allowed registry module. All unrelated production files, modules, nodes and special hashes remain fail-closed.
